scoring.rule: Each of ten categories has equal weight. Unverified requirements fail closed; partial evidence receives half credit.

route_coverage.note: Legacy basic-contract coverage; retained as a subordinate metric and not used as the overall badge value.

evidence_layers.source: local candidate plus pinned public AVDS documents

checks: local browser acceptance: 14/14 route × viewport cells without horizontal overflow, console errors or visual-craft blockers
local modal source boundary and locale-specific missing-attribution projection
Public evidence is release-specific and is intentionally not reused for a changed local candidate.
After separately authorized promotion, require check_runtime_evidence.py, smoke_live.sh and browser proof against the exact release identity.
